crossRefs.note: “For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are…
You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;
who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed…
traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they…
“They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they…
Their tongue is a deadly arrow. It speaks deceit. One speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his…
You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning…
Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and…

translations.web: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth.
translations.bsb: You love evil more than good, falsehood more than speaking truth. Selah
translations.kjv: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
translations.asv: Thou lovest evil more than good, And lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah
